notes: Export your scan as a text or HTML report to keep or share.
patch_notes:
You can now export the last scan as a report: an Export report button saves it as text or HTML, with the files by category, the biggest folders and the system space hogs, so you can keep it or share it.
The report is read-only — exporting never touches the files it lists.
The button is only enabled when a scan has results.
